scheme_name: Transgender Welfare Board | Official Website of Department of Social Welfare Uttar Pradesh, India.

History: The Transgender Welfare Board's roots lie in the 2014 Supreme Court decision in NALSA vs. Union of India, which recognized transgender people as a third gender. In Uttar Pradesh, its formal launch took place in 2021, when the state government constituted the Transgender Welfare Board. The process of issuing unique identity cards (ID cards) began in 2023, and ID cards are currently being issued. This covers approximately 137,465 transgender people across the state's 75 districts, based on the 2011 census. The scheme is linked to the Government of India's SMILE (Support for Marginalized Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise) scheme.
Objective: The scheme's primary objective is to establish the identity of transgender individuals, provide them with constitutional rights and livelihood opportunities, and ensure their inclusion in mainstream society. This scheme eliminates social discrimination and promotes economic independence, education, and access to health services.
Benefits of the scheme: Identity Card (ID Card): It is necessary to avail the benefits of government schemes. Pension: Monthly pension to transgenders above 60 years of age. Old age home facility: Free accommodation, food, health check-up, and mental counselling for those above 60 years of age. Scholarship: Education assistance to transgender students Skill Development and Employment: Training under the SMILE Scheme, association with the Chief Minister Entrepreneur Development Campaign, and rehabilitation in Garima Grih. Other: Ration cards, health services, and social security. These benefits help make the community self-reliant.
Eligibility for the scheme: Criteria Description Age No age limit for ID card; above 60 years for pension/old age home. Social class Transgender person. Economic situation Any income group (especially the economically weaker sections). Residence Native of Uttar Pradesh. Other Medical/Affidavit proof of being transgender; must not have availed of benefits in the past.
Required Documents: Documents Description Email ID and mobile number For contact and OTP verification. residence certificate Must have proof of original residence in Uttar Pradesh. Photo ID Aadhar Card or other valid ID. Passport-size photo Recent color photo. Signature/Thumb Impression In digital form. Affidavit Affidavit on Form-2 stating that one is transgender. Income Certificate For pension/special benefits (if applicable).
Key Points for Issuance of Identity Certificates
1. Procedures for Issuance of Identity C: Basis of application: The District Magistrate (DM) will take action on the basis of the affidavit (Form-2) declaring the gender identity of the person. No medical examination required: This affidavit will be submitted without any medical examination. Identification number: If the application is found to be correct, the DM will issue an identification number to the applicant, which will be used as proof of the application. Determination of place of residence: For domicile, the applicant must be a resident of the district magistrate's jurisdiction as of the date of application. Only an affidavit in Form 2 will be required, and no other certificate will be requested.
2. Issuance of ID Certificate for Transg: Issuance procedure: The DM shall issue an identity certificate in Form-3, stating the gender of such person, in the manner prescribed in Rule 4. Deadline: The certificate shall be issued within thirty (30) days of receipt of the duly completed application and affidavit. Effect: This Identity Certificate will be the basis for changing the gender, name, and photograph of the transgender person in all government documents as prescribed in Annexure-1. Identity Card: The DM will also issue a Transgender Person Identity Card in Form-5 to the applicant.
3. Procedure for Issuance of ID Certific: Medical intervention: If a transgender person seeks medical intervention to change their gender to male or female. Application: The person can apply to the DM in Form-1 for issuance of a revised identity certificate. Required Certificates: A medical certificate issued by the medical superintendent or chief medical officer of the medical institution must be attached with the application. Investigation by DM: The DM will only verify the authenticity of the medical certificate, which will not involve any physical examination. Place of residence: For place of residence, the applicant must be a resident of the area falling under the jurisdiction of the DM on the date of application, and an affidavit to this effect must be submitted along with the application in Form-1 (no additional proof will be asked for).
4. Issuance of Revised ID Certificate un: Revised certificate: The DM will issue a revised certificate in Form-4 to the applicant seeking gender change, in which the concerned person will be shown as male or female. Deadline: The amended certificate shall be issued within fifteen (15) days of receipt of the application. Effect: This revised Identity Certificate will entitle the transgender person to record or change his/her gender and photograph as well as name in all the government documents as given in Annexure-1, as per the male or female as specified in the certificate. Amendments to official documents: After amendment of official documents based on identity proof, their serial number or reference number will be the same as that in the original official document.
Application Process: The application process is primarily online. Websites for ID cards: https://transgender.dosje.gov.in But The application is free Online Step-by-Step Process (For ID Card):

Registration: Register on the portal with email and mobile number. Login & Forms: Click on "Login" and select "Apply for Transgender Certificate/Identity Card." Enter personal details (name, address, gender, etc.) and press "Save & Next." Document Upload: Upload photo, affidavit/medical certificate, and signature. Declaration and Submission: Fill out the declaration form, check "I agree," and click "Final Submission." Press "Submit Now" in the pop-up. Status Check: Log in and track your "Application Status." Approval is by the District Magistrate. Other benefits: After getting the ID, apply separately for a pension/scholarship on the Kalyansathi portal, or contact the District Social Welfare Officer.
Disclaimer:- For more information visit the official website https://transgender.dosje.gov.in on or https://twb.upsdc.gov.in Visit or contact the District Social Welfare Officer.
